finalText:
Build now passes with exit code 0, 3 warnings / 0 errors.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17`: `resolveConfig` referenced a bare `retries` variable that was never defined (it should have used the `env.retries` argument passed in), throwing a `ReferenceError` during the link stage and aborting the build. Everything else — the hundreds of "compile ok", tree-shaking notes, and dedupe lines — was just noise. Fixed it to `env.retries || 3`, matching the fallback-to-constant behavior the comment already described.

The 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are still there but non-blocking — let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
